name: restatement-v1
description: Twenty-four delegation plans, each stating three facts — six tasks or not, different files or not, writing or not — crossed with eight question texts about those same facts. Seven of the eight are restatements, whose answer the state asserts; the eighth is the independence inference delegate-fan-out gates on. The panel separates polarity, conjunction, and restatement in general as explanations for openagents#9414. Labels are read off the state by the rule each item carries.
